title: Ensure branch deletions are denied
description: Deleting a protected branch removes both the code and the protections attached to it. Recreating it afterwards restores neither the history nor the restrictions. A restriction that exempts people does not stop them deleting the branch, so an exemption is the same exposure as no restriction at all for whoever holds it.
remediation: Repository settings -> Branch permissions -> Add restriction: select the default branch and enable "Prevent deletion". Then review the restriction's exempt users and groups: an exemption granted to a team group covers everyone who joins it later, which is how a restriction comes to bind nobody it was meant to. Name the service accounts that genuinely need one in allowedBypassPrincipals, and set thresholds.maxBypassPrincipals to how many other principals may hold one (-1 turns the check off). Configure it at Project settings -> Branch permissions to cover every repository in the project.
fixSummary: Block deletion at Repository settings -> Branch permissions; check who is exempt.
